requirement: The system shall hold `note`, `task`, `event`, and `contact` PIRs together in one current collection.
verification_idea: Create one of each type and list the collection.

requirement: The system shall create a `note` PIR containing its required `text` field.
verification_idea: Add a note and show its stored text.

requirement: The system shall create a `task` PIR containing its required `description` and `deadline` fields.
verification_idea: Add a task and show both fields.

requirement: The system shall create an `event` PIR containing its required `description`, `start_time`, and `alarm_time` fields without imposing an order between the two times.
verification_idea: Add an event and show all three fields, including a past time or an alarm after its start.

requirement: The system shall create a `contact` PIR containing its required `name`, `address`, and `mobile_number` fields.
verification_idea: Add a contact and show all three fields, including a number with `+` or a leading zero.

requirement: The system shall reject any missing, multiline, or whitespace-only required data field and store each accepted field after trimming its leading and trailing whitespace.
verification_idea: Try missing, blank, multiline, and padded values for every schema; inspect accepted values and rejected operations.

requirement: The system shall accept time-field values only in valid local `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` 24-hour format at minute precision, including valid past times.
verification_idea: Try valid, impossible-date, wrong-format, and timezone-bearing values; confirm past values are accepted.

requirement: The system shall preserve a mobile number as text, including `+` and leading zeros, without region-specific validation.
verification_idea: Save and show such a number; try a nonempty mobile string without a region-specific pattern.

requirement: The system shall assign each successfully created PIR a unique positive integer ID, starting at 1 and increasing for later creations without reassigning an ID after deletion or loading a file.
verification_idea: Create, delete, and create records; load an older snapshot and create again; compare assigned IDs.

requirement: The system shall leave the next ID unchanged when creation fails.
verification_idea: Make an invalid `add` between two valid adds and compare assigned IDs.

requirement: The system shall allow different PIRs to have equal data-field values.
verification_idea: Create two records with identical data and observe distinct IDs.

requirement: The system shall recognize the command forms listed in §6.1 and reject missing or extra arguments.
verification_idea: Exercise every form, then remove or add an argument to representative commands.

requirement: The system shall match command names, PIR type names, and field names without regard to letter case.
verification_idea: Repeat representative commands with mixed-case names.

requirement: The `add` command shall take data values in the schema order shown in §6.1 and reject an unknown type or a wrong number of fields.
verification_idea: Add each type in order, then supply an unknown type and too few or too many values.

requirement: The command interface shall parse quoted arguments with spaces and the `\"` and `\\` escapes, and reject malformed quoting or any other escape.
verification_idea: Use spaced and escaped text/path arguments, then unmatched quotes and an unsupported escape.

requirement: The `update ID FIELD "VALUE"` command shall change exactly one existing data field of the PIR selected by ID after applying that field's validation rules.
verification_idea: Update one field of each PIR type; show that other fields are unchanged.

requirement: The system shall reject an update to an absent PIR, a field absent from its type, its ID, or its type, without changing the PIR.
verification_idea: Attempt each invalid update and compare the record before and after.

requirement: The `list [TYPE]` command shall show every PIR, or only PIRs of the specified canonical type, in ascending ID order with ID, type, and its complete first text field.
verification_idea: List a mixed collection with and without a type filter and compare order and full summary text.

requirement: The `show ID` command shall display the ID, type, and every data field of the selected PIR.
verification_idea: Show one PIR of each type and check every field.

requirement: The `show all` command shall display the complete details of every current PIR in ascending ID order.
verification_idea: Create mixed records and compare displayed details and order.

requirement: The system shall clearly report an empty collection or an empty `list` type filter instead of presenting a PIR as found.
verification_idea: Run `list` and `show all` on an empty collection and `list TYPE` with no matching type.

requirement: The `delete ID` command shall remove only the specified existing PIR from the current collection.
verification_idea: Delete one of multiple records and show the remaining records.

requirement: The system shall report an absent or invalid ID for `show`, `update`, or `delete` without changing the collection.
verification_idea: Try zero, negative, noninteger, and missing IDs and compare state.

requirement: The `help` command shall display the available command forms and the record, quoting, time, and search syntax needed to use them.
verification_idea: Compare help output with the command and syntax definitions in this SRS.

requirement: The `exit` command or end of input shall terminate the command session normally.
verification_idea: Run a session ending with `exit` and another ending at EOF.

requirement: The `search EXPR` command shall parse its remaining input as one criterion and reject an empty expression.
verification_idea: Submit a valid expression, no expression, and a truncated expression.

requirement: A valid `search` command shall evaluate its criterion against every PIR in the current collection during that command.
verification_idea: Create matching and nonmatching PIRs of several types, search, and compare the result set.

requirement: The system shall support a type atom `type = "TYPE"` where `TYPE` is one of the four canonical PIR types, matched without regard to case.
verification_idea: Search for each type with mixed-case type literals; reject an unknown type literal.

requirement: The system shall support `FIELD contains "STRING"` for `text`, `description`, `name`, `address`, and `mobile_number`, with a nonempty quoted string.
verification_idea: Search each of the five text fields; reject empty or unquoted strings.

requirement: Text containment shall ignore letter case and match a string occurring anywhere in the applicable field value.
verification_idea: Search for an interior substring using different case and compare positive and negative matches.

requirement: The system shall support `<`, `>`, and `=` comparisons on each of `deadline`, `start_time`, and `alarm_time` against a quoted valid `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` value.
verification_idea: Exercise all nine field-operator pairs, plus invalid and unquoted time literals.

requirement: Time comparisons shall compare the represented local date and minute chronologically.
verification_idea: Test before, after, and equal times across day and month boundaries.

requirement: The `&&` operator shall match a PIR only when both operand conditions match it.
verification_idea: Test all four truth combinations of two atoms.

requirement: The `||` operator shall match a PIR when at least one operand condition matches it.
verification_idea: Test all four truth combinations of two atoms.

requirement: The `!` operator shall invert the match result of its following condition.
verification_idea: Negate matching and nonmatching atoms and a parenthesized expression.

requirement: The system shall evaluate parentheses first, then `!`, then `&&`, then `||`.
verification_idea: Compare expressions whose results distinguish each precedence level and explicit grouping.

requirement: A valid atom referring to a field absent from the PIR type being tested shall evaluate false for that PIR, so negating that atom evaluates true.
verification_idea: Evaluate `deadline` on a note and its negation on the same note.

requirement: The system shall reject the entire search for an unknown field, unsupported operator, invalid literal, malformed expression, or unmatched parenthesis without displaying partial matches or changing stored data.
verification_idea: Submit one case of each error after creating records; compare state and output.

requirement: Search results shall be displayed in ascending ID order with each match's ID, type, and complete first text field.
verification_idea: Create matches in mixed type order and compare the resulting summaries and order.

requirement: A valid search with no matches shall clearly report that no PIR matched.
verification_idea: Search for a valid criterion that matches none of the current PIRs.

requirement: The `save "PATH.pim"` command shall store the complete current PIR collection in a file whose extension is exactly `.pim`.
verification_idea: Save four PIR types, inspect the file path and contents, and reject other extensions.

requirement: A saved file shall use the version 1 UTF-8 JSON structure and exact record schemas stated in §6.3.
verification_idea: Parse a saved file and check encoding, top-level keys/values, IDs, order, and each record's fields.

requirement: Saving shall write to a temporary sibling file and replace the destination only after successful serialization, leaving the previous destination intact if saving fails.
verification_idea: Inspect the save procedure's temporary path; induce a write/serialization failure and compare the destination's previous bytes.

requirement: The `load "PATH.pim"` command shall read a `.pim` file and validate its complete contents before changing current state.
verification_idea: Load a valid file and separately attempt truncated, wrong-extension, and unreadable files.

requirement: Load validation shall reject an incorrect format or version, missing or extra keys or fields, invalid field values, nonpositive or duplicate IDs, or a `next_id` no greater than the maximum stored ID.
verification_idea: Mutate one aspect of an otherwise valid file for each listed category and attempt load.

requirement: Successful loading shall replace, rather than merge with, the current collection and shall use the greater of the pre-load and file `next_id` values for later creation.
verification_idea: Load a snapshot over different in-memory records, including an older snapshot with a lower counter; add a PIR and inspect the assigned ID.

requirement: A failed load shall preserve the entire prior in-memory collection and next ID.
verification_idea: Record state and the next assigned ID, attempt invalid loads, then compare state and ID assignment.

requirement: The system shall resolve a relative `save` or `load` path against the process working directory.
verification_idea: Run from a chosen directory and use relative paths for save and load.

requirement: An unknown command, invalid argument, invalid path or file, or I/O failure shall produce an error message identifying the rejected input or failure category and return to the command prompt.
verification_idea: Exercise each error category, inspect the message for the input or category, and issue a subsequent valid command.

requirement: A failed command shall not partially change the in-memory collection.
verification_idea: Compare the collection before and after failed create, update, delete, search, save, and load operations.

requirement: The delivered PIM shall operate through a local command-line interface without requiring a GUI or network connection.
verification_idea: Run the documented commands with network unavailable and no graphical session.

requirement: The delivered PIM shall run under Python 3.11 and each newer Python version explicitly listed as supported in the developer manual on its documented platform.
verification_idea: Run its documented launch and acceptance commands with Python 3.11 and every later version listed as supported.

requirement: The PIM implementation shall invoke only Python standard-library modules.
verification_idea: Audit runtime imports and run from an environment without third-party packages.

requirement: All code belonging to the system model shall reside in a separate package named `model`.
verification_idea: Inspect the package tree and model behavior exercised by unit tests.

requirement: The command-facing and file-facing major components shall be identifiable separately from the `model` package.
verification_idea: Inspect the delivered source layout and its design document for responsibility mapping.
